properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.description: Time-to-live for pending async conversion tasks in milliseconds. Tasks older than this will be evicted from memory to prevent leaks.

properties.label: advanced

properties.name: batchFailOnFirstError
properties.label: batch
properties.description: Fail entire batch on first error (true) or continue processing remaining documents (false)

properties.name: batchParallelism
properties.label: batch
properties.description: Number of parallel threads for batch processing

properties.name: batchSize
properties.label: batch
properties.description: Number of documents to submit per sub-batch. Documents are partitioned into sub-batches of this size and each sub-batch is processed before starting the next one. Within each sub-batch, up to batchParallelism threads are used concurrently. This controls memory usage and back-pressure when processing large document sets.

properties.name: batchTimeout
properties.label: batch
properties.description: Maximum time to wait for batch completion in milliseconds

properties.name: splitBatchResults
properties.label: batch
properties.description: Split batch results into individual exchanges (one per document) instead of single BatchProcessingResults

properties.name: chunkingIncludeRawText
properties.label: chunking
properties.description: Include raw text in chunk output

properties.name: chunkingMaxTokens
properties.label: chunking
properties.description: Maximum number of tokens per chunk for hybrid chunking

properties.name: chunkingMergePeers
properties.label: chunking
properties.description: Whether to merge peer chunks in hybrid chunking

properties.name: chunkingTokenizer
properties.label: chunking
properties.description: Tokenizer model for hybrid chunking (e.g. sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

properties.name: chunkingUseMarkdownTables
properties.label: chunking
properties.description: Use markdown format for tables in chunk output

properties.name: includeMetadataInHeaders
properties.label: metadata
properties.description: Include metadata in message headers when extracting metadata

properties.name: includeRawMetadata
properties.label: metadata
properties.description: Include raw metadata as returned by the parser

properties.name: allowFilePathSource
properties.label: security
properties.description: Whether a String message body that starts with / or contains \ is interpreted as a local filesystem path to read. When disabled, such a body is rejected instead of being read. This does not affect the CamelDoclingInputFilePath header, nor File, byte or explicit path collection bodies used by the batch operations.

properties.name: allowUrlSource
properties.label: security
properties.description: Whether a String message body that starts with http:// or https:// is interpreted as a remote URL for Docling to fetch. When disabled, such a body is rejected instead of being fetched. This does not affect the CamelDoclingInputFilePath header, nor bodies of any other type.

properties.name: apiKeyHeader
properties.label: security
properties.description: Header name for API key authentication

properties.name: authenticationScheme
properties.label: security
properties.description: Authentication scheme (BEARER, API_KEY, NONE)

properties.name: authenticationToken
properties.label: security
properties.description: Authentication token for docling-serve API (Bearer token or API key)

properties.name: inputBaseDirectory
properties.label: security
properties.description: When set, every local input file path must resolve inside this directory once normalized. Applies to the CamelDoclingInputFilePath header, to file path message bodies, and to the paths used by the batch operations. When empty, no directory restriction is applied.

properties.name: maxFileSize
properties.label: security
properties.description: Maximum file size in bytes for processing

properties.name: oauthProfile
properties.label: security
properties.description: OAuth profile name for obtaining an access token via the OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials grant. When set, the token is acquired from the configured identity provider and used as authenticationToken. Requires camel-oauth on the classpath.

properties.name: outputBaseDirectory
properties.label: security
properties.description: When set, the output directory passed to the docling CLI must resolve inside this directory once normalized. Applies to the CamelDoclingOutputFilePath header. The check is lexical and does not resolve symbolic links, matching inputBaseDirectory. When empty, no directory restriction is applied and the header value is only normalized.
